entities.name: Hand
entities.description: The overall hand entity including dominance, symmetry, flexibility, and line density.

entities.name: Hand Shape
entities.description: The elemental and physical shape categorization of the hands (e.g. Earth, Air).

entities.name: Physical Feature
entities.description: General physical qualities of the hand skin, thickness, muscle, texture, and color.

entities.name: Palm
entities.description: The palm dimensions, proportions, and muscle fullness.

entities.name: Finger
entities.description: The fingers (excluding thumb) and their observable lengths, spacings, and leans.

entities.name: Thumb
entities.description: The thumb - the core of willpower, logic, flexibility, and angles.

entities.name: Mount
entities.description: The fleshy mounts of the palm representing mental, emotional, and physical reserves.

entities.name: Major Line
entities.description: The primary paths of energy (Life, Head, Heart, Fate, Sun, Mercury).

entities.name: Minor Line
entities.description: Auxiliary lines like Marriage, Travel, Solomon's Ring, Girdle of Venus.

entities.name: Mark
entities.description: Traditional symbols observed on mounts and lines (Star, Cross, Square, Trident, etc.).

entities.name: Nail
entities.description: The shape, color, texture, and crescent (lunula) of the fingernails.

entities.name: Fingerprint
entities.description: The dermatoglyphic patterns (Loops, Whorls, Arches, Composite).

entities.name: Timing
entities.description: Age markers calculated along major and minor lines.

relationships.name: contains
relationships.description: Expresses structural hierarchy (e.g. Hand contains Fingers).

relationships.name: parallel_to
relationships.description: Expresses alignment parallel to another line.

relationships.name: supports
relationships.description: Signifies energy reinforcement (e.g. sister line supports major line).

relationships.name: contradicts
relationships.description: Opposing meanings that resolve through rules.
